purpose: Derive the eighth C2 long-tail promotion queue into source-specific deep-read tasks so each pain, trauma, neurodevelopment, sensory-communication, autonomic, BCI or living neural computation domain-source pair can later be checked for exact claim use, endpoints, population/setting, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position before any reviewed artifact or model admission.

scope.selectionRule: Derive one queued source-specific extraction task for every candidate source attached to every C2-LT-B8 promotion row.
currentLimitations: This queue derives deep-read tasks; it does not contain completed local review or independent fresh review.
A queued task is not evidence that the cited source supports the domain claim seed.
Candidate URLs require source-context reading and may still need manual access if a guideline page, publisher page, neurotechnology policy instrument, or scientific article blocks automated checks.
No task may be promoted into reviewed Source Cards, variables, endpoints, downgrade checks or calibrated models until exact source-context fields and fresh review are complete.

queueDefaults.minimumExtractionQuestion: For this C2-LT-B8 domain-source pair, what exact claim, endpoint, population/setting, mechanism/effect signal, uncertainty, transfer boundary and downgrade trigger can this source support without overclaiming?
